principles: Verifier authority cannot be waived by reviewer judgment
One canonical verifier and stable diagnostics
drivers: Open Decision 10 requires explicit eligible roles and mechanical independence
Wave 2A must be separately auditable from review_pass and scope-check artifacts
Existing signing and freshness infrastructure should be reused rather than reimplemented
Adversarial mutation proof must expose any prompt-only or caller-authored bypass

options.name: A: Dedicated critic and exclusion artifacts with shared signing primitives
cons: Adds commands, artifacts, role prompt, and lifecycle integration

options.name: B: Extend generic review_pass and scope-check records
cons: Conflates code review with topology authority
Cannot express all required receipt bindings cleanly

options.name: C: Embed critic fields in proofstory.json
cons: Weakens writer provenance and atomic signed receipt semantics

chosen: A: Dedicated critic and exclusion artifacts with shared signing primitives
rationale: Dedicated signed artifacts keep critic and exclusion authority independently attributable while reusing canonical workspace, signature, freshness, and storyFilesHash readers. This directly satisfies Wave 2A without granting critic prose authority over the verifier-derived basis.

preMortem.scenario: Implementer self-signs a critic receipt using an allowed role string
preMortem.trigger: Verifier checks role text but not agent/session/dispatch/commit provenance
preMortem.mitigation: Recompute all provenance dimensions and reject any implementer overlap; add isolated mutations for each dimension.

preMortem.scenario: A valid critic receipt remains accepted after topology, scope, or source closure changes
preMortem.trigger: One required digest is omitted from the signed payload or freshness reader
preMortem.mitigation: Bind every V1 field and mutate each digest/hash independently with exact restoration tests.

preMortem.scenario: Critic or exclusion approval converts incomplete discovery into a pass
preMortem.trigger: Gate combines critic verdict before evaluating basis completeness
preMortem.mitigation: Evaluate basis status first and make missing/partial/unsupported/stale/tampered unconditionally non-pass.

preMortem.scenario: Wave 2A accidentally introduces Wave 3 executable requirements or enables rollout
preMortem.trigger: Critic check is coupled to pre_review_check or legacy enforce configuration
preMortem.consequence: Scope leakage and unrelated Stories block
preMortem.mitigation: Keep structural critic evidence separate, default observe, and assert no executable/pre-review/selective-rollout facts are required or claimed.
